name: Heroine
source:
A fortune teller-matchmaker who can see the Red Strings of Fate. Hired by Heinz to be a maid in the Gardner family mansion since she's broke. Her personality depends on the player's choices.

[From [url=https://heartstringsvn.wordpress.com/game/]official website[/url]]
